name: Robust Cycle-Agreement Gluing Bound
statement: For supplied piece certificates with margins $t_j$ and section rows $a^j$, choose target rows $b$ and $q_j\ge1$ whose simple-cycle ratios differ from those of $a^j$ by at most $q_j^{|\gamma|}$. If $q_j^2-1<t_j$, then $b$ extends to every piece at the explicit positive margin $u=\min_j(t_j-(q_j^2-1))/(Q(a^j,b)q_j^2)^L$, and $\mu(X)\ge u^2/(1+2u)$.
proof: The diagonal sandwich theorem supplies approximate row and coordinate factors. Fitting the rows to the target changes each evaluation by at most $q_j^2-1$; rescaling then loses at most the displayed path-length factor. Apply section-row compatibility.
